scenario.note: Short-time working in year 2 is required to be at least three times that in year 1.
The number of workers made redundant in year 1 is at most 1.5 times the number in year 2.
The rule limits semi-skilled workers on short-time working to no more than 5% of the total short-time workforce by setting a relative cap on their short-time presence.

validation_errors.message: a rule carries either `value` (absolute) or `relative_to` + `factor` (relative), not both and not neither

scenario.note: The share of semi-skilled workers on short-time working is capped at 5% of the total semi-skilled workforce.
